mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warn_dispose_task (task_no, event_id, assignee_id, assigner_id, measure, deadline, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{eventId}, #{assigneeId}, #{assignerId}, #{measure}, #{deadline}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_no AS taskNo, event_id AS eventId, assignee_id AS assigneeId, assigner_id AS assignerId, measure, deadline, status, finish_time AS finishTime FROM warn_dispose_task WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE warn_dispose_task SET status = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE warn_dispose_task SET status = 3, finish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2
UPDATE warn_dispose_task SET status = 4, update_time = NOW() WHERE status IN (1, 2) AND deadline < #{now} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.task_no AS taskNo, t.event_id AS eventId, t.assignee_id AS assigneeId, t.assigner_id AS assignerId, t.measure, t.deadline, t.status, t.finish_time AS finishTime FROM warn_dispose_task t JOIN warn_event e ON e.id = t.event_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warn_dispose_task t JOIN warn_event e ON e.id = t.event_id WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warn_dispose_feedback (task_id, feedback_user_id, content, images, feedback_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{feedbackUserId}, #{content}, #{images}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id AS taskId, feedback_user_id AS feedbackUserId, content, images, feedback_time AS feedbackTime FROM warn_dispose_feedback WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
